issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted) specifies a third dependency kind `verifies` letting an author declare 'this bead checks that bead', plus an advisory structural diagnosis for `blocks` edges whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead (an inverted verification gate). No open bead covers R025. Scope: schema/storage support for the edge kind, CLI surface on `bead dep`, the diagnostic report (report only — never insert-time rejection, never title heuristics), audit-event and checkpoint round-trip coverage for the new edge kind, concurrency tests, and help/schema-explain doc updates. ADR-001's measured evidence (45 inverted edges across two live workspaces, 4–6% of new beads) makes this a silent-deadlock mode for fleet work: readiness is computed correctly against a semantically wrong graph, so nothing ever flags it.

issue.close_reason:
Completed npm checksum enforcement and acceptance coverage in af3fe9c and 13d16c5, already delivered on main. The compiled ruleset now validates npm bodies as 30 random base62 characters plus a 6-character base62 CRC32, with RULESET_VERSION 4. The module test round-trips 30+6 and rejects a tampered trailer. The CLI test dynamically builds a conforming candidate, verifies exit 2 with secret_detected and no mutation, verifies a tampered candidate is admitted with checksum_failed advisory output, and verifies doctor JSON reports the finding without disclosing the value. The first archive gate run inherited BEAD_ORG_SECRET_SCANNER from the host and exposed seven duplicate organization-scanner findings; the documented native-rule isolation BEAD_ORG_SECRET_SCANNER=off was then used. In a clean git-archive extraction of committed HEAD, the full definition of done passed; the worktree status was checked before staging and all dirty paths were unrelated fleet changes, so none were staged. The checkpoint was current after bead evidence update. git push origin main reported Everything up-to-date and origin/main..HEAD was empty.

```verified:
BEAD_ORG_SECRET_SCANNER=off scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast exit=0
BEAD_ORG_SECRET_SCANNER=off scripts/definition-of-done.sh exit=0
```

issue.description: Defect against the accepted secret-rejection-v1. The npm rule treats the last 8 of 36 body characters as a base62 CRC32 of the first 28. The published npm format is the GitHub scheme: 30 random characters followed by a 6-character base62 CRC32. Every conforming npm publish credential is therefore reported as checksum_failed and admitted; reproduced 2026-10-03 with a runtime-assembled candidate against 0.2.6. The module unit test uses a 26 plus 8 body that the 36-character pattern cannot match. Correct the width, replace the test with a 30 plus 6 round trip and a tampered negative, and prove through the CLI that a conforming candidate exits 2 with secret_detected while a tampered one is admitted with an advisory checksum_failed finding. This change opens ruleset 4: set RULESET_VERSION to 4 here; later R040 beads add to the same unfrozen version (ADR-023 item 8, secret-ruleset-v4 section 4.5). Does not wait for BR-T35. Verify with cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test.
issue.notes: Implemented and delivered in commits af3fe9c and 13d16c5 (HEAD eddc05e): npm checksum validation and encoding now use the published 30 random characters plus 6-character base62 CRC32 layout; RULESET_VERSION is 4. Unit coverage round-trips a 30+6 value and rejects a tampered trailer. CLI coverage dynamically generates a conforming npm candidate (never storing one), verifies create exits 2 with secret_detected, verifies a tampered candidate is admitted with checksum_failed advisory output, and verifies doctor JSON reports the checksum_failed finding. Verified committed HEAD from a git-archive extraction: scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast exit=0; with BEAD_ORG_SECRET_SCANNER=off, scripts/definition-of-done.sh exit=0, including cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test (330 lib tests, 325 bin tests, integration suite, and doctests all passed); focused npm CLI test exit=0. The default full suite without BEAD_ORG_SECRET_SCANNER=off exposed seven pre-existing duplicate organization-scanner findings, so native ruleset verification used the documented isolation. Worktree status was inspected; all listed dirty paths are unrelated fleet work and were not staged. origin/main..HEAD is empty.
